audit.whatIsWrong: Difficulty prose is accurate at EVEN (49.93% WR over 4440 games), but the lane-difficulty drivers were never stated: Sylas's threat is Kingslayer sustain and Hijack, not a stun.
audit.why: Riot text for Abscond / Abduct is a 400-range dash with a recast pull — no stun. Multiple fields called it a 'chain-stun'.
audit.corrected: Early lane is LeBlanc's on range (Q 700, E 925 vs Chain Lash 775 and Kingslayer 400). Level 6 and late flip on Hijack (950 range) and Kingslayer sustain (12/10.5/9/7.5/6).

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 spike described as requiring a landed E; first-item spike attributed his healing to Petricite Burst.
audit.why: Hijack is a 950-range ult steal with no CC prerequisite. Healing is on Kingslayer (W); Petricite Burst is an on-attack magic damage/attack-speed passive with no heal.
audit.corrected: Spikes: LeBlanc 2/3 (Q sigil + W detonation), 6 (Mimic), first item. Sylas 6 (Hijack, 80s rank 1) and first item onward (Kingslayer heal scaling).

audit.whatIsWrong: Ability interactions were generic; the decisive ones were absent.
audit.why: Kit ranges decide this lane: LeBlanc E (925) outranges every Sylas tool except Hijack (950); Sylas W (400) and E (400) both require him to be on top of you; LeBlanc W has a 4s return window against Sylas E's 13s rank-1 cooldown.
audit.corrected: Chain him at 925 outside Chain Lash's 775. W in, sigil, W out inside his 13s Abscond cooldown. Kingslayer heals every 12s down to 6s — Grievous Wounds decides extended trades. Hijack takes your Mimic without needing to land anything.

audit.why: It is the field that holds real cooldowns.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart disagreed across layers: content win[0..6] read LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Sylas/LeBlanc/Sylas while every full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill'.
audit.why: Two layers rendering different answers to 'who wins Level 1'. The packet levelChart matches the content layer exactly, so the content layer is correct and the full layer is stale.
audit.corrected: phases[N].side moved to match win[N] and the packet chart, with every why rewritten in the same proposal to argue the same verdict.

edits.before: Q-auto the trades — the sigil mark is half your damage; never throw Q without the detonation plan.
edits.after: Q at 700 outranges his Kingslayer lunge at 400 — poke and step back; the sigil is half your damage.

edits.before: W online: the Q-W double-proc chunk is live, and the return trip makes it free. The lane flinches now.
edits.after: W at 2: Q sigil then W detonation, and the 4-second return leaves before Kingslayer can heal the trade back.

edits.before: E joins: Q-E chains hold targets for the full string. Pick one tether window per wave.
edits.after: E at 3: chain him at 925 range, outside Chain Lash's 775, and detonate the sigil on the root.

edits.before: W-poke the wave contacts and return before his answer — distortion math is the whole champion.
edits.after: W in, Q sigil, W back before Abscond returns — his E is 13s at rank 1 and he cannot follow.

edits.before: Mimic online — the double-dash crosses the lane and the burst doubles. Most mids die to the first full chain.
edits.after: Hijack outranges nothing you can dodge — at 950 it takes your Mimic outright, and his first ult is an 80-second one. Hold R.

edits.before: First item spike: Q-W-RW deletes squishies. Spend the lane lead before scaling lanes wake.
edits.after: First item: Q sigil, W detonation, RW — he dies before Kingslayer heals that back.

edits.before: Late LeBlanc picks: W the flank, chain the carry, mimic the exit — and vanish before the obituary prints.
edits.after: Kingslayer heals off you every 6s at rank 5 and Hijack is a 30-second steal — he outlasts a burst that misses.

edits.before: - Sylas Abscond / Abduct: matchup-defining — Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Count it out loud if you must. - Your W Distortion (return) has one job: the moment it all goes wrong. - The R has one too: the moment it all goes right.
edits.after: - Abscond / Abduct: 13s at rank 1, 9s at rank 5 — his only gap-closer, so step up the moment it is spent. - Kingslayer: 12s falling to 6s, the heal that undoes your chip. - Hijack: 80s at rank 1 — burn his window, then take yours.

edits.before: Sylas wins by landing Abscond / Abduct, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Sylas wins by taking your Mimic with Hijack, then Abduct-pulling you to 400 range and healing the trade back with Kingslayer.

edits.before: Ahead, sprint the window: chain Sylas off every contact, roam with round-trip math, and end before two items dull the knife.
edits.after: Ahead, deny the steal: kill him before 6, and after it force him to spend Hijack on a wave so your R answers his 80-second timer.

edits.before: Carry through picks — one chained carry per objective; your job is the flank angle and the discipline to leave after.
edits.after: Carry through picks — chain him before he reaches 950 and casts Hijack, and take fights where his 400-range dash finds nobody.

edits.before: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Until it’s spent, every commit is a coin flip.
edits.after: Abscond dashes 400 and recasts into a pull, not a stun — 13s at rank 1, so poke the ground he has to cross.

edits.before: Q the sigil, W the detonation, return before the answer — a half-bar round trip he experienced as weather.
edits.after: When he Abduct-pulls onto you, E him on the landing — the shackle roots at 1.5s and his 13-second dash is already gone.

edits.before: Sylas spends Abscond / Abduct early — the closest thing this matchup has to a guarantee.
edits.after: Mimic W is the exit, not the opener — R is 45s at rank 1 and dying with it banked is the loss.

edits.before: That’s Sylas’s bread-and-butter play — deny it and they run out of answers.
edits.after: Kingslayer is 400 range and heals off you — inside it, his lunge pays for itself.

edits.before: Staying at the W landing spot for one more auto — the return timer is your champion; outliving it is optional.
edits.after: Kingslayer comes back every 6 seconds at rank 5 off your health bar — an even-HP extended duel ends with him ahead.

edits.before: Track Sylas’s Abscond / Abduct: Dash into chain-stun — punish him hard while it is down. Forward steps wait for its downtime.
edits.after: Track Sylas's Abscond / Abduct: a 400-range dash that recasts into a pull, 13s at rank 1 — step up the moment he spends it.

edits.before: Hijack lets him steal your Mimic off a landed stun, flipping the level 6 spike his way
edits.after: Hijack takes your Mimic from 950 range with no setup, flipping the level 6 spike

edits.before: Item-fueled healing starts letting your burst get out-sustained in extended trades
edits.after: Kingslayer healing plus first-item power out-sustains a burst that does not kill

edits.before: Sylas's Hijack lets him steal your own Mimic ultimate if he lands E on you, turning your all-in into his kill — hold R for repositioning, not for engaging into his stun.
edits.after: Sylas's Hijack steals your Mimic from 950 range — no E needed — and turns it back on you, so hold R for the exit and never reveal it while his 80-second ult is up.

edits.before: Sylas's healing from Petricite Burst plus early item power starts letting him win extended trades even when your burst lands first.
edits.after: Sylas's healing comes from Kingslayer (W), 9s at rank 3 — with early items it wins him extended trades even when your burst lands first.

edits.before: Levels 3-5 your combo still kills him first, but the moment he hits 6 the matchup flips hard: Hijack lets him steal your own Mimic ult off a landed E stun, so avoid using R carelessly and never walk into his stun range once he's level 6. Play the level 6 spike very cautiously.
edits.after: Levels 3-5 your combo still kills him first, but level 6 flips it: Hijack takes your Mimic from 950 range with no setup, so never show R while his ult is up. Abduct pulls, it does not stun — the danger is being dragged to 400 range where Kingslayer heals him through your combo.

notes: Level chart was in cross-layer disagreement: content win[0..6] and packet.levelChart both read LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/LeBlanc/Sylas/LeBlanc/Sylas, while all seven full-layer phases[N].side read 'Skill'. The content layer matches the packet, so I moved the full layer to it and rewrote all seven whys in the same proposal; no win[N] edits are needed because win[N] already holds the correct values. phases[N].rating left untouched deliberately — I could not confirm from the data whether the rating is owner-favourability or difficulty, and inverting it wrongly is worse than leaving it. Two factual errors corrected: Sylas's sustain is Kingslayer (W), not Petricite Burst (which is an on-attack damage/attack-speed passive with no heal), and Abscond / Abduct is a dash with a recast pull, not a stun — the 'chain-stun' phrasing appeared in four separate fields. Hijack has no CC prerequisite; it is a 950-range steal, so 'if he lands E on you' was wrong. Anti-heal need from missingInteractions is already covered by report[8] ('Add anti-heal early into his sustain'), so no edit there. breakdown.wave judged templated but I could not ground it in anything Sylas-specific beyond what other fields already say, so I left it — see sectionsMissing in the run notes. | COHERENCE: 1 chart edit(s) withdrawn — they moved the row to the enemy while leaving the phase why describing the owner winning it. Chart authority is an open question, so the label was reverted rather than the prose rewritten. Re-propose only as a side+why pair.
